question: भुट्टे (Corn) का रंग (Color) कैसा होता है? 🌽
explanation: Awesome! भुट्टा (Corn) has bright पीला (Yellow) and sweet kernels! 🌽
hint: It is the same color as the sun.

question: हम (We) भुट्टे पर क्या लगाते (Rub) हैं? 🍋
explanation: Great job! नींबू (Lemon) and नमक (Salt) make the roasted corn taste so delicious! 😋
hint: One is sour and one is salty.

question: हम भुट्टा (Corn) किस मौसम (Season) में खाते हैं? 🌧️
explanation: Yay! Eating hot corn during the बारिश (Rain) is the best feeling! 🌧️
hint: Water falls from the clouds in this season.

question: बारिश (Rain) से बचने के लिए हम क्या लेते हैं? ☂️
explanation: Super! We use a छाता (Umbrella) to stay dry in the rain! ☂️
hint: You open it over your head.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) को किस पर भूनते (Roast) हैं? 🔥
explanation: Yay! The vendor cooks it on hot आग (Fire) to make it tasty! ♨️
hint: It is very hot and red.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) का छिलका (Husk) किस रंग का होता है? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! The outer छिलका (Husk) of the corn is fresh हरा (Green)! 🌿
hint: It is the color of leaves.

question: नींबू (Lemon) का स्वाद (Taste) कैसा होता है? 🍋
explanation: Awesome! नींबू (Lemon) is very खट्टा (Sour) but so yummy! 🍋
hint: It makes your eyes blink!

question: आग (Fire) पर भुनने के बाद भुट्टा (Corn) कैसा होता है? ♨️
explanation: Good job! Roasted corn is very गरम (Hot) and smells great! ♨️
hint: You have to blow air on it before eating.

question: गरम (Hot) भुट्टे को हम कैसे खाते हैं? 🌬️
explanation: Brilliant! We cool it down by फूँक मारकर (Blowing air) before eating! 🌬️
hint: You use your mouth to push air.

question: भुट्टा (Corn) कहाँ उगता (Grows) है? 🌱
explanation: Super star! Tall corn plants grow in the खेत (Field)! 🌽
hint: A big open land where farmers work.

question: हम भुट्टा (Corn) किससे चबाते (Chew) हैं? 😬
explanation: Great! We use our strong दाँत (Teeth) to chew the corn! 🦷
hint: They are white and inside your mouth.

question: बारिश (Rain) में आसमान (Sky) में क्या छा जाते हैं? ☁️
explanation: Yay! Dark बादल (Clouds) fill the sky before it rains! ☁️
hint: They are fluffy and float high up.

question: भुट्टा (Corn) कौन बेचता (Sells) है? 🛒
explanation: Awesome! The friendly ठेले वाला (Vendor) roasts and sells corn! 🌽
hint: A person standing with a wooden cart.

question: नमक (Salt) का रंग (Color) कैसा होता है? 🧂
explanation: Perfect! नमक (Salt) is a shiny सफ़ेद (White) powder! 🧂
hint: It is the same color as milk.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) को हम किससे पकड़ते (Hold) हैं? 🤲
explanation: Good job! We use our हाथ (Hand) to hold the yummy corn! ✋
hint: You have five fingers on it.

question: गरम भुट्टे (Corn) से कैसी खुशबू (Smell) आती है? 👃
explanation: Fantastic! Roasted corn has a very अच्छी (Good) smell! ♨️
hint: It makes you want to eat it right away.

question: बारिश (Rain) में हम बाहर क्या पहनते हैं? 🧥
explanation: Super! We wear a रेनकोट (Raincoat) so we don't get wet! 🧥
hint: A special jacket for the rain.

question: कोयला (Coal) किस रंग (Color) का होता है? 🪨
explanation: Yay! कोयला (Coal) is ⚫ (Black) and gets very hot when burning! 🔥
hint: It is the color of the dark night.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के दानों (Kernels) की लाइन (Line) कैसी होती है? 📏
explanation: Awesome! The kernels grow in beautiful सीधी (Straight) lines! 🌽
hint: Like a neat row of students.

question: मज़ेदार (Tasty) भुट्टा खाकर हम कैसा महसूस करते हैं? 🥰
explanation: Brilliant! Eating yummy food makes us very खुश (Happy)! 😊
hint: You smile a lot!

question: भुट्टे (Corn) को खेत (Field) में कौन उगाता है? 👨‍🌾
explanation: Great! The hard-working किसान (Farmer) grows corn for us! 🌱
hint: A person who drives a tractor.

question: नींबू (Lemon) का आकार (Shape) कैसा होता है? 🍋
explanation: Yay! नींबू (Lemon) is a small, गोल (Round) yellow fruit! 🍋
hint: Like a small ball.

question: बारिश (Rain) की बूँदें (Drops) कैसी होती हैं? 💧
explanation: Super star! Raindrops are cool and गीली (Wet)! ☔
hint: They leave water on your clothes.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) को भूनते समय क्या निकलता है? 💨
explanation: Perfect! Roasting on a fire creates a little धुआं (Smoke)! 🌫️
hint: A grey cloud coming from the hot fire.

question: परिवार (Family) के साथ भुट्टा (Corn) खाने में क्या आता है? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Awesome! Sharing treats with family is so much मज़ा (Fun)! 🥳
hint: You laugh and enjoy together.

question: आग (Fire) का रंग (Color) कैसा होता है? 🔥
explanation: Good job! आग (Fire) glows bright लाल (Red) and orange! 🔥
hint: The color of an apple.

question: हम भुट्टा (Corn) किसके साथ बाँटकर (Share) खाते हैं? 🍽️
explanation: Yay! We love to share our food with our sweet परिवार (Family)! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
hint: Your parents, brothers, and sisters.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के छिलके (Husk) को हम क्या करते हैं? 🌿
explanation: Fantastic! We हटाते हैं (Remove) the green husk to find the yellow corn! 🌽
hint: You take it off and throw it away.

question: आसमान (Sky) में काले बादल (Clouds) क्या लाते हैं? 🌩️
explanation: Super! Dark clouds mean झमाझम बारिश (Rain) is coming! ☔
hint: Water falling from the sky.

question: आग (Fire) पर भुनने से भुट्टा (Corn) कैसा हो जाता है? 🔥
explanation: Brilliant! The heat makes the hard kernels nice and नरम (Soft)! 😋
hint: Easy to chew.

question: बारिश (Rain) में बच्चे (Children) कहाँ खेलना पसंद करते हैं? 👦👧
explanation: Yay! Jumping in the rain पानी (Water) is the best game! 💦
hint: Puddles on the ground.

question: ठेले (Cart) में बहुत सारे भुट्टे (Corn) कैसे रखे होते हैं? 🌽🌽
explanation: Awesome! Vendors arrange them सजाकर (Decorated) beautifully in neat rows! 🌽
hint: Looking neat and beautiful.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के छोटे हिस्सों को क्या कहते हैं? 🌽
explanation: Great! The small yellow dots are called दाने (Kernels)! 🟡
hint: Little yellow pieces you eat.

question: गरम और मज़ेदार भुट्टा देखकर हमारे मुँह (Mouth) में क्या आता है? 🤤
explanation: Yay! Yummy food makes our mouth fill with पानी (Water)! 🤤
hint: It happens when you are very hungry for a treat.

question: ठेले वाला भुट्टे (Corn) पर मसाला (Spice) कैसे लगाता है? 🍋
explanation: Super star! He rubs the lemon and salt रगड़ कर (Rubbing) all over! 🍋🧂
hint: Moving the lemon back and forth on the corn.

question: बादल (Cloud) जब गरजते हैं, तो क्या होती है? ⚡
explanation: Perfect! Thunder makes a loud, booming आवाज़ (Sound)! 🌩️
hint: You hear it with your ears.

question: हम भुट्टे (Corn) के लिए ठेले वाले को क्या देते हैं? 🪙
explanation: Good job! We pay पैसे (Money) to buy delicious things! 🪙
hint: Coins and notes.

question: भुट्टे के दाने (Kernels) कैसे चबाने (Chew) चाहिए? 🦷
explanation: Awesome! Eating धीरे-धीरे (Slowly) is good for our tummy! 😋
hint: Not too fast.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के दानों (Kernels) के अंदर कैसा रस (Juice) होता है? 😋
explanation: Yay! The tiny kernels pop with a lovely मीठा (Sweet) juice! 🌽
hint: Tastes like sugar.

question: भुट्टा (Corn) खाना हमारी सेहत (Health) के लिए कैसा है? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Fantastic! Corn is very healthy and अच्छा (Good) for us! 💪
hint: Makes you strong.

question: बारिश (Rain) में कौन सा पक्षी (Bird) पंख फैलाकर नाचता है? 🦚
explanation: Brilliant! The beautiful मोर (Peacock) dances when it rains! 🦚
hint: A big bird with blue and green feathers.

question: ठेले वाला कोयले (Coal) को हवा (Air) कैसे देता है? 🌬️
explanation: Super! He uses a hand fan (पंखे से) to keep the fire burning! 🔥
hint: A tool you wave to create wind.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के ऊपर के बाल (Silk) छूने में कैसे होते हैं? 🌾
explanation: Yay! The fine threads on top of corn are very मुलायम (Soft) like silk! 🌾
hint: Feels smooth like your teddy bear.

question: आग (Fire) से हमें क्या मिलती है? ♨️
explanation: Awesome! आग (Fire) gives out bright light and गर्मी (Heat)! 🔥
hint: It keeps us warm.

question: भुट्टे (Corn) के खेत (Fields) कैसे दिखते हैं? 🌱
explanation: Great! Farms full of tall corn plants look fresh and हरे-भरे (Green)! 🌱
hint: The color of nature and plants.

question: हम भुट्टा (Corn) किस समय (Time) खाना पसंद करते हैं? 🌆
explanation: Perfect! Eating roasted corn in the शाम (Evening) breeze is the best! 🌆
hint: When the sun goes down.

question: बारिश (Rain) की आवाज़ (Sound) कैसी होती है? 🌧️
explanation: Yay! The rain makes a musical छम-छम (Pitter-patter) sound! 🌧️
hint: The rhythm of water drops falling.

question: भुट्टा (Corn) खाने के लिए हमें क्या खोलना पड़ता है? 😮
explanation: Super star! Open your मुँह (Mouth) wide to take a big bite! 😋
hint: Where your teeth and tongue are.

question: ठेले वाला भुट्टा (Corn) किसमें लपेटकर (Wrap) देता है? 🌽
explanation: Brilliant! Vendors often wrap the hot corn back in its green छिलके (Husk) to hold it! 🌿
hint: The natural green cover.

question: नींबू और नमक वाला भुट्टा (Corn) कैसा लगता है? 🤤
explanation: Awesome! Tangy lemon and salt make it so स्वादिष्ट (Yummy)! 😍
hint: Very, very tasty!
